t: Many uses in a vast range of settings, environments and workplaces. Suitable for any metal application. High viscous formula wont drip or run, even staying put when applied to vertical surfaces. Use as a grease up to 115°C and as a liquid up to 260°C. Protects against rust and corrosion. Sprays on easily with a thick, protective coating for auto hinges, gears, sprockets, winches and chains, latches, door tracks, pulleys, cables, tow bars and guide rails. Flip straw down for spray, or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows upright or upside-down application.
b: Can be Applied to Vertical Surfaces
Safe to Use on All Metal Surfaces
